labInfo.title: Lab Work 5 - Vue 3 and VeeValidate
labInfo.description: This lab focuses on using the VeeValidate library to validate forms and data in a Vue 3 application. You will create a testing program that ensures data accuracy, allows navigation between questions, and verifies answers after test completion.

tasks.integrateVeeValidate: Integrate VeeValidate into the Vue project for form validation.

tasks.developTestInterface: Develop a question-based test interface that allows navigation between questions.
tasks.validateAnswers: Validate answers in real-time and store them for final review.
tasks.displaySummary: Display a summary of correct and incorrect answers after test completion.
